name: company-a
description: Synthetic Company A case with planted clues. All names, registers and domains are invented (.test). Gold answers are set by construction; null means the item is not scored on that question.

case.premise: Company A, a Zurich waste-transport firm, won municipal contracts after its ownership passed to an undisclosed holder in 2025.

ownership: Who has held Company A's shares since 2025?
